Edgar Lee Masters, Spoon River Anthology.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-lee-masters/spoon-river-anthology

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Lee Masters, the author, died 1950.

First publication of the text used: 1916 (SE colophon: 'Spoon River Anthology was published in 1916 by Edgar Lee Masters.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1916, before 1931, so it is in the public domain in the United States.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa, and each has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die died in 1950, so the text is public domain in each of these countries from 1 January 2021 at the latest.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

- SE colophon: 'Spoon River Anthology was published in 1916 by Edgar Lee Masters.'
- Wikidata Q468247 (Edgar Lee Masters), death dates in the facts file: 1950-03-05, 1950-05-05; Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Edgar_Lee_Masters
